summary: Enliven Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a public offering of 8,933,334 shares at $37.50/share plus 1,733,333 pre-funded warrants at $37.499 each, with a 30-day greenshoe option for 1,600,000 additional shares. Net proceeds ~$376M ($432.4M if option exercised). The offering is a follow-on under an existing S-3ASR shelf, not a special situation. It is a routine capital raise with no transformative event. No board recommendation or advisor; the underwriting agreement was with Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Barclays. Expect close June 15, 2026; watch for price stability and potential dilution absorption.
